native_date_validation.scope: Native Date schema validation at full TimeClip boundaries, malformed calendar components, invalid zero dates, nested array abort behavior, raw failed outputs and default/factory/config schema issue fields. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

native_union.scope: Type-changing native union candidate selection, original inputs for aggregate failures, empty/single/multiple/mixed branches, transformations/fallbacks, nested array/map/set/struct raw outputs and nested generic struct callback compilation, callback traces, recursive issues, abort settings and factory/config messages. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

maybe_conversion.scope: Transparent native Maybe and nested Maybe Number/BigInt/Boolean/Date/native String/default parseBoolean conversions, absent/null/value states, scalar/date/bigint/symbol/JSON payloads and factory issue fields. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

maybe_json.scope: Native Maybe missing/undefined/null/value serialization at root, array, map, field and nested positions; hooks, dates, BigInt rejection, callbacks and parseJson-to-stringify pipelines with reviver deletion. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately.

boxed_date.scope: Dates in json2.Any across numeric/boolean/date-copy conversions and JSON serialization phases, provider/replacer ordering, invalid dates and nonprimitive hook rejection. Native Date display and array Date parsing are tested separately. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

numeric_representation.scope: Native signed/unsigned widths including isize/usize, narrow JSON numeric alternatives, checks/conversions/messages, native precision boundaries, boxed equality, JSON adapters and primitive hooks. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

json_interaction.scope: Native value-based descendant hook retention under shallow/deep parent replacements, callback order/errors, nil and non-nil provider/encoder/JSON pointers, field omission and original raw pointer outputs.

partial_equality.scope: Native scalar widths, NaN/signed zero and composite value equality in mixed failed sets/maps; explicit object interning models native value equality, with all abort settings.

json_presence.scope: Presence-aware replacer recovery/omission/null/error behavior for undefined and toJSON outputs at root/array/map positions, including callback order and issues.

struct_json.scope: Nested native struct toJSON hooks, V field tags, options, fixed/dynamic arrays, maps, Date/scalars, embedded collisions, whitelist and replacer order/errors. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately.

wrapper_audit.scope: Original wrapped schemas, shape operations around pipelines/fallbacks, factory messages, introspection and abort behavior.

json_runtime_audit.scope: Iterative deep serialization through depth 4096 and exact UTF-16 indentation output. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

native_hook_audit.scope: Native primitive/toJSON hooks, hints, lazy replacer/whitelist order, failures, dates and built-in class serialization. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

cache_identity_audit.scope: Forty cache observations across four identified message callback identity scenarios.

json_number_audit.scope: Opt-in ECMAScript binary64 parsing/stringification, original source spans, overflow and malformed numbers.

raw_output_audit.scope: Type-changing failed outputs, invalid dates, skipped transformations and nested native partial collection/struct snapshots. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately.

entry_map_audit.scope: Arbitrary object keys, explicit identity/equality, transformed collisions in typed and raw output, exact path keys and abort behavior.

default_state_audit.scope: Computed value/null/undefined defaults, contextual introspection and original input states.

native_value.scope: Date and bigint equality, bounds and memberships with full issue fields; extended ISO years and arbitrary integer precision. Reference rows exclude JavaScript-specific date parsing/display behavior; native Date conformance is tested separately.

dynamic_set.scope: Deterministic mixed JSON scalar sets, numeric representation equality, NaN, infinities, insertion order and signed zero.

custom_check.scope: Partial readiness, array wildcard paths, empty selections, guard kinds, canonical issues and all abort/message settings.

default_context.scope: Computed defaults with input datasets, optional introspection datasets, configuration, callback traces and invalid defaults.

json_holder.scope: Reviver/replacer holder snapshots, sibling values, previous sibling replacements and callback traces. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

error_path.scope: Dot paths, flatten groups, empty/unsupported keys and error summaries; native prototype-free map projection.

action.scope: Full validation issue fields and UTF-16 fragments; factory/config messages. Word comparisons exclude Japanese/Thai dictionary tailoring; native tests cover those counts. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

array_callback.scope: Original-array callback arguments, call order, short circuiting and output.

boolean_config.scope: Custom truthy/falsy lists, Unicode normalization and SameValueZero scalar equality.

collection_action.scope: Collection counts, MIME types, item predicates and content checks.

composition.scope: 531 recursive schema descriptors, all four abort settings, typed state, all JSON-projected outputs and full recursive issue fields. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

conversion.scope: String conversions, Unicode boolean lists and complete transformation issue fields. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

fallback_context.scope: Fallback dataset/config callbacks, introspection and call traces.

forward.scope: Forwarded paths and existing issue paths. Exact case tags separate native presence-based map/index traversal from legacy truthiness and missing-path exceptions.

introspection.scope: Direct and recursive default/fallback getters for every composition descriptor.

json_coercion.scope: JSON scalar/array/object conversions, nonfinite values and coercion errors. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

json_config.scope: Reviver source/order/deletion, replacers, whitelists and indentation. Reviewed observation IDs and native-only tags are listed in tools/oracle/native_cases.json; generation reports retained and excluded outcomes separately.

message_context.scope: Message precedence, callback counts and issue metadata for both languages and all abort settings.

native_collection.scope: Native array/set/map/record partial outputs, errors, flattening and abort behavior.

pipeline.scope: Raw callback datasets, typed state, issue accumulation and transformation boundaries.

presence.scope: Native Maybe states, defaults, non-presence wrappers, output state and schema issue fields.

number.scope: Exact binary64 rounding bits, subnormals, overflow, radix boundaries and 8192 seeded floating inputs. Reviewed native text-policy differences are reported by explicit case ID.
